notes: Fixes a display bug you may have already hit. Anywhere a name contained a double quote — a wiki entry like 20x25x1" filter, a recipe like Grandma's 9" Pie, a calendar event like Lunch with "the Bobs" — the page could render wrong around it, because quotes weren't being escaped when the hub built the page. They are now, everywhere. Behind that, the twenty page scripts each carried their own private copy of the same handful of helper functions; there is now one shared file, which is what made the escaping fixable in one place instead of twenty. Also restores something the wall kiosks were quietly missing when not signed in: their icons and their print button.
